phases.name: host-check
phases.action: Validate all fixed host paths/hashes and scoped owned-actor inactivity before the SSH transaction.

phases.name: device-apply
phases.action: New pinned helper staging; device runtime and full target preflight; exact manifest mutations; helper removal only after success.

phases.name: host-apply
phases.action: Revalidate host guards and full target preflight, then apply only fixed host targets after device success.

device_transport.occupied_path_policy: Refuse; no reuse, emptying, alternate path or retry.

checks: Exact recovered service fingerprints, drop-ins, environment, command, idle job and Xochitl identity
Owned tablet clients inactive/not-found, known XOVI/adapter/proxy/rebuilder/AppLoad modules unmapped, UI9821 listener absent
Pinned terminal actor record unchanged and prior actor PID125204 absent
Host executing UID/GID1000; bounded same-UID process argv/cwd/executable matching against exact legacy roots; unknown visibility or matching active actor refuses cleanup
runtime_guards.unknown_process_values: Never print or store; ephemeral matching only. No process stop/kill action.

deletion_rules.unknown_or_retained_children: Preserve supporting marker/root; never enumerate recursively or remove unknown entries.
deletion_rules.directory_removal: Exact planned rmdir only. A late nonempty-directory error stops remaining work.
deletion_rules.partial_outcome: Report actual removed and retained paths. No automatic retry, rollback, fresh discovery or claim of atomic cleanup.

preserved: Returned original proxy/hash/stat/current service configuration/other original extensions.
SOURCE/evidence/history/parent approvals/durable outputs/private and synthetic documents.
Opaque state.json and actual .tablet-state-* interrupted temp records, without reading/resetting them.
Unknown/unowned/unsafe/missing paths and all files not explicitly listed in a later approved manifest.
Every opaque state.json and interrupted .tablet-state-* file, without reading or hashing.
Ownership markers and roots supporting any preserved state, logs, PDFs or unknown entries.
Original /home/root/xovi/extensions.d/webserver-remote.so and all original extensions/service/boot/cloud/account settings.
All repository source, workflow receipts, approvals, artifacts, local execution records and durable image-annotator outputs.
Already removed helper /home/root/pi-ink-offline-reader-0029: no new operation on that path.
local_attempt: execution-0036/attempt.json reserved exclusively before host-check. Existing execution directory blocks reuse. Each captured phase and result remain local evidence, not phase receipts.

authority.required: Separate exact irreversible approval for this frozen plan and manifest, USB remains connected, and exclusive operator handoff. Fresh worktree ownership/liveness/reservation inspection and independent phase session before actual execution.
excluded: Process stop/restart/kill actions other than timeout control of this executor transaction
Source changes, merge, push or ticket completion

proof_limits: No production host targets or tablet were accessed during preparation.
Current runtime actor/service/path identities are not established by synthetic tests; guards will refuse changed or missing paths.
Only the named manifest scope can finish. Retained state/logs/PDFs and unknown entries remain; no universal credential-erasure claim.
ARM64 format and build verified offline, not a hardware cleanup run.
